import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,base64
p=Path.cwd()
for name,terms in [('inputs/product.pdf',['Definition 5.2','Theorem 5.4 (','Lemma 5.11','Theorem 5.13 (','[23] Reinhard']),('sources/covering-semigroup.pdf',['Lemma 3.5.','Lemma 3.7.','main assumptions'])]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/name),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
 pages=r.stdout.split('\f');chosen=[]
 for t in terms:
  hits=[i+1 for i,s in enumerate(pages) if t in s];print(name,t,hits)
  chosen.extend(hits)
 for num in sorted(set(chosen)):
  r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(num),'-singlefile','-scale-to','1600','-png',str(p/name)],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
  dest='rendered/'+Path(name).stem+'-'+str(num)+'.png'
  w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),dest,'--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode(),text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
  print(dest)
lines=(p/'inputs/product.txt').read_text().splitlines()
for a,b in [(1170,1275),(1625,1700)]:print('\n'.join(f'{i}: {l}' for i,l in enumerate(lines[a:b],a)))
